game.name: Leisure Suit Larry: Love for Sail!
game.desc: Larry Laffer is on a cruise ship and wants to win the captain's contest and the girls on board. A comic point-and-click style adventure for mobile phones, with puzzles, inventory items and minigames such as Spank-a-Monkey. Runs the original J2ME game on a MIDP shim with SDL2 video.
